_comment: LAUNCH SET ONLY (2026-11-16): the five documents the store reviews need (Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Child Safety Policy, Support, Account deletion). The other drafts in docs/legal/ are postponed and are not served. Generator config for the public legal pages (LR-04, docs/release/legal-pages-hosting.md, Option A). Read by scripts/legal/legal_pages.py. THE SWITCH: 'publish' stays false until the owner's confirmed values are applied and counsel has reviewed the text (docs/legal/apply-confirmed-values.md). While it is false the build is skipped and Admin Web answers 404 at /legal/. Setting it to true does not force anything out: the generator still refuses every page that carries a placeholder, a review marker, a drafting note or a draft status.
